clue.text: Position adopted by idlers in desperate straits

definitions.meaning: loafers lounge leaning their rear against a wall, a literal posture
the idiom for being cornered with no way to retreat

explanation.surface: A description of where layabouts stand, apparently explaining their hopeless situation.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase literally describes leaning against a wall and figuratively means being cornered with no escape.

clue.text: Clip joints?

parts.note: a clip joint is a club that overcharges, but here it is literally a place where hair gets clipped

explanation.definitionFit: Places where hair is clipped are literally joints, slang for establishments, devoted to clipping.

clue.text: He explored Canada initially, with boat all at sea

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of the word Canada
being all at sea means confused, so the letters of boat are jumbled

explanation.surface: A historical note about an explorer of Canada sailing a disorganised boat.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a fact about the explorer, but 'Canada' is only there for its first letter; the man's own voyages make it a fair nudge.
explanation.definitionFit: John Cabot was the Venetian navigator who reached the North American coast in 1497 for England.

clue.text: A fishmonger, for example?

parts.note: a fishmonger deals in flatfish, so is a dealer in one particular fish

explanation.definitionFit: An exclusive distributor is a business term; read literally it is someone who sells the flatfish.

clue.text: Naturally, such food is grown

parts.note: food raised without artificial chemicals is described by this label

explanation.definitionFit: Produce farmed without synthetic fertilisers or pesticides carries this label, meaning naturally raised.

clue.text: An armrest?

parts.note: arm here means a firearm, and the rest is the place a pistol sits

explanation.definitionFit: A leather case worn on the hip is where a pistol, a firearm, rests.

clue.text: Swore to reform but hasn't got any better

indicators.note: to reform is to form again, so the letters of the first word are reshaped

explanation.surface: Someone vowed to change their ways but is still no improvement.
explanation.definitionFit: Going downhill rather than improving is the comparative of bad, the opposite of better.

clue.text: Fall in love, yet become discouraged

definitions.meaning: to give one's heart away to someone is to fall for them
to lose courage or spirit and give up hope

explanation.surface: A romantic who falls for someone yet grows dispirited.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both giving away one's affections and losing courage or spirit.

clue.text: Brew of beer left to rise

indicators.note: a brew is a mixture stirred up, so the letters of beer are mixed

explanation.surface: Some home-brewed beer is set aside for the yeast to work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brew of' turns BEER into REBE. 'to rise' looks like the beer fermenting but is the definition, rising up in revolt.
explanation.definitionFit: To rebel is to rise up against authority, as insurgents do.

clue.text: Large-scale migration for those seeking earthly riches

definitions.text: Large-scale migration for those seeking earthly riches

parts.words: Large-scale migration for those seeking earthly riches
parts.note: earthly riches is literal, precious metal dug from the ground, as in California in 1849

explanation.definitionFit: Prospectors flocked in huge numbers to sites such as California and the Klondike to dig for the precious metal.

clue.text: Lose no time to suppress loquacity

parts.note: to step on something is to crush or suppress it
gas is informal for idle talk or chatter

explanation.surface: Advice to cut chatter short and get on with things.
explanation.walkthrough: The motoring idiom for accelerating is read literally as squashing talk.
explanation.definitionFit: Pressing the accelerator pedal is an idiom for hurrying up.

clue.text: Board transport in a violent rainstorm

indicators.note: in says the letters sit inside the words violent rainstorm

explanation.surface: Getting on a train or bus while a storm rages outside.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across the join of 'violENT RAINstorm'.
explanation.definitionFit: To board a railway carriage, so getting on a means of transport.

clue.text: He set to, prepared for the first golf stroke

indicators.note: prepared means made ready or worked up, so the three words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A golfer gets ready to start a round.
explanation.definitionFit: The opening drive on each hole is struck from a peg on the starting area.

clue.text: Try to walk like a crab and slide about

definitions.text: Try to walk like a crab

indicators.note: about signals turning the letters around, so the word slide is rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone attempting a crab's sideways scuttle and slipping around.
explanation.definitionFit: Crabs move sideways, and edging sideways furtively is the verb here.

clue.text: Mom denied coming from such a disreputable class

indicators.note: the answer's letters come out of the two words, rearranged

explanation.surface: Mother denies she belongs to a shady social set.
explanation.definitionFit: A French term for women of dubious respectability on society's fringes, a disreputable set.

clue.text: He can't be trusted with a deal

definitions.text: He can't be trusted with a deal

parts.words: He can't be trusted with a deal
parts.note: a deal is literally the dealing of a pack of cards, not a business transaction

explanation.definitionFit: A cheat at card games manipulates the deal, so is untrustworthy when dealing.

clue.text: Romanians reformed this republic

indicators.note: reformed means put into a new shape, so the letters of Romanians are rearranged

explanation.surface: People from Romania remodel their nation's government.
explanation.definitionFit: The tiny state enclaved in Italy is one of the world's oldest republics.

clue.text: Powerless to get substandard player suspended

parts.note: a ham is a poor, overacting performer
strung up means hung or suspended

explanation.surface: A weak team member is dropped and left unable to play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suspended' looks like a ban from play, but means hung.
explanation.definitionFit: Being crippled, literally with leg tendons cut, came to mean rendered ineffective.

clue.text: Livery stable

definitions.meaning: livery is the distinctive dress of servants or staff
stable here is an adjective meaning constant or unvarying

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an official outfit like livery and unchanging, as in a constant rate.

clue.text: Trees as old as the ark?

definitions.text: Trees as old as the ark?

parts.words: Trees as old as the ark?
parts.note: Genesis says Noah built the ark of a particular wood, so the timber is literally that old

explanation.definitionFit: In the King James Bible, Noah builds his vessel from gopher wood, so these trees are of Noah's era.

clue.text: Either way, it's unacceptable

indicators.note: either way says the letters read the same forwards and backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: However you look at it, the matter cannot be allowed.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is a palindrome, so 'Either way' gives the wordplay while 'unacceptable' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: The informal British idiom for something that simply will not do.

clue.text: It could not cope with a burning issue of AD 79

definitions.text: It could not cope with a burning issue of AD 79

parts.words: It could not cope with a burning issue of AD 79
parts.note: a burning issue is literally the lava and ash that issued from Vesuvius in that year

explanation.definitionFit: The Roman town near Naples was buried by the eruption of Vesuvius in the year 79.

clue.text: Be way out about a point

indicators.note: about here means around, so one piece goes round the other

parts.note: an exit is a way out
S, south, is a compass point

explanation.surface: Being far away somewhere around a certain spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' wraps EXIT around S, giving EXI-S-T.
explanation.definitionFit: To be is to have existence, so the two verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Old Egyptian gambling game, it's said

indicators.note: it's said signals a word that sounds like the answer when spoken

parts.note: faro is an old card game played for stakes

explanation.surface: Talk of an ancient Egyptian betting game.
explanation.walkthrough: FARO, the card game, is pronounced like the ruler's title.
explanation.definitionFit: The title given to the ancient kings of Egypt.

clue.text: Bail set before one delivers defence

indicators.note: before puts the rearranged letters ahead of the next piece
set means arranged, so the letters of Bail are rearranged

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Once bail is fixed, the accused's case is presented in court.
explanation.definitionFit: A plea that one was elsewhere when the crime happened is a form of legal defence.

clue.text: Changing diet not a remedy

indicators.note: changing means altering, so the letters of the three words are reordered

explanation.surface: Altering what you eat is not a cure.
explanation.definitionFit: A counteracting medicine for poison, and by extension any remedy.

clue.text: Finishing off a cake?

parts.note: finishing off suggests eating the last slice but means the final decorative coat

explanation.definitionFit: The sugary coating is the last thing applied when making a cake, its finish.

clue.text: When these retirement accounts are closed, all interest should cease

definitions.text: When these retirement accounts are closed, all interest should cease

parts.words: When these retirement accounts are closed, all interest should cease
parts.note: retirement means going to bed, accounts means tales, and interest means a child's attention, not finance

explanation.definitionFit: Tales read to children at lights-out; once the book shuts, the child should fall asleep.
